lessons.title: Cross-Page Relative Navigation Mandate
lessons.rule: In multi-page websites, NEVER use bare anchor hashes (e.g. href="#featured", href="#services", href="#about") in the navigation of secondary pages. All cross-page links must be relative (e.g. href="about.html", href="projects.html", href="skills.html", or href="index.html#featured").

lessons.title: Header & Footer Route Consistency
lessons.rule: The desktop <header> and mobile navigation drawer MUST provide the exact same page routes across all sibling pages. Only the .active class / aria-current="page" attribute may differ to highlight the current active file.

lessons.title: Zero Markdown or Conversational Leakage
lessons.rule: Never include markdown backtick fences (```html or ```) or conversational commentary (e.g. 'This completes the HTML structure...') in generated code files. Output pure, clean HTML/CSS/JS only.

lessons.title: Strict DOM Tag Matching & Unique IDs
lessons.rule: Ensure every opened tag has a single matching closing tag. Never emit orphan closing tags or duplicate overlay IDs (such as multiple id="drawerOverlay").

lessons.title: Universal Mobile Drawer Functionality
lessons.rule: Every page with a hamburger button (#mobileMenuBtn) MUST have a corresponding mobile drawer (#mobileDrawer) and overlay (#drawerOverlay), wired with a clean working JavaScript open/close toggle script.

lessons.title: Duplicate Overlay Id
lessons.rule: Ensure every DOM ID like #drawerOverlay is unique; never emit duplicate overlay elements.

lessons.title: Broken Internal Link
lessons.rule: All relative links in headers, drawers, and buttons must link to files that actually exist in the package.
